evidence: NEW: func_00387CA4 is now proven to be a pure getter by its own disassembly - `cmp r1,#0xff; ldreq r0,[r0,#0xc4]; addne r0,r0,r1,lsl #2; ldrne r0,[r0,#0x24]; bx lr` - no stores, no calls. The wrapper's disassembly is `push {r3,lr}; bl Os_GetGameWork; ldr r0,[r0]; ldr r0,[r0,#8]; ldr r0,[r0,#0x7c]; cmp r0,#0; movne r1,#0x22; blne func_00387CA4; pop {r3,pc}`, so r0 survives the pop and the function returns the entry (Ghidra typed it void and dropped the return). index 0x22 selects mgr->f_24[0x22]. The manager is work+8->+0x7C, the menu manager of FACTS.md.

params.channel: 4 = red, 5 = green, 8 = blue, anything else = white
